svg.title: KVCache-centric distributed inference system architecture (SysML-style)
svg.desc: Left compute & scheduling plane drawn as nested SysML containment with cardinality: one service gateway fans out to N clusters (S3 inter-cluster), each cluster routes among M instances (S2 inter-instance), each instance is an xPyD prefill/decode disaggregation that scales dynamically and may use different parallelism such as TP4 vs TP8 (S1 PD-phase), and each prefill/decode node runs an in-engine scheduler over its GPU HBM (S0 intra-machine). Right KVCache data plane holds a four-level storage hierarchy L1 HBM, L2 DDR, L2.5 CXL, L3 SSD, L4 shared pool, with small eviction/prefetch arrows and per-transition latency/bandwidth between tiers, S0-S3 radius tags, and a KV directory queried by the cluster router and fed by KV-manager events.
